acronymexpander.title: Acronym Expander
acronymexpander.description: Acronym Expander resolves acronyms and abbreviations into their full meanings, complete with subject categories and definitions. Submit any short term up to 20 characters to get matching expansions and explanations for each domain.

params.name: acronym
params.description: The acronym to expand (max 20 characters)

params.name: context
params.description: Optional context to help determine the correct meaning

acronymgenerator.title: Acronym Generator
acronymgenerator.description: Acronym Generator creates acronyms from phrases by extracting the first letter of each word. Input 'Application Programming Interface' and get 'API'.

params.name: text
params.description: The phrase to generate an acronym from (must contain at least 2 words)

acrostic.title: Acrostic Puzzle Generator
acrostic.description: Acrostic Puzzle Generator creates puzzles where the first letters of answer words spell out a hidden keyword.

params.name: word
params.description: The keyword to spell out (3-15 letters)

params.name: theme
params.description: Theme: random, positive, nature, adventure, friendship, learning

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

advice.title: Advice Generator
advice.description: Advice Generator supplies random pieces of advice on demand. Each response includes a unique advice identifier, the advice quote, and the language code.

agecalculator.title: Age Calculator
agecalculator.description: Age Calculator converts a date of birth into exact age broken down by years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, and seconds. It also provides the age in written words and a countdown to the next birthday.

params.name: dob
params.description: The date of birth to calculate the age from (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone used to interpret the date of birth and to determine "today" when computing the age

airlinelookup.title: Airline Lookup
airlinelookup.description: Airline Lookup is an airline codes API that matches IATA codes and airline names to carrier profiles, returning the official title, callsign, registration country, and low-cost status. Paid tiers add three-letter ICAO code lookups and carrier logo URLs.

params.name: iata
params.description: The IATA code of the airline for which you want to get the information (e.g., AA)

airportcodeconverter.title: Airport Code Converter
airportcodeconverter.description: Airport Code Converter is an IATA code API that converts between 3-letter IATA and 4-letter ICAO airport codes. Submit either identifier to receive the matching code, official airport name, city, state, and country code.

params.name: code
params.description: The airport code to convert (IATA: 3 letters, ICAO: 4 letters)

airportdistance.title: Airport Distance
airportdistance.description: Airport Distance calculates the great-circle distance between two airports, plus estimated travel time, using their 3-letter IATA codes. It provides route distance in miles and kilometers plus estimated flight duration.

params.name: iata1
params.description: The IATA code of the first airport (e.g. JFK)

params.name: iata2
params.description: The IATA code of the second airport (e.g. LAX)

airports.title: Airports Lookup
airports.description: Airports Lookup resolves 3-letter IATA codes into official airport names, matching ICAO codes, cities, states, and country codes. Paid plans add ICAO code lookups, geographic coordinates, elevation, and local timezones across more than 40,000 facilities.

params.name: iata
params.description: The IATA code of the airport for which you want to get the information (e.g., MCI)

airquality.title: Air Quality
airquality.description: Air Quality is an air pollution API that reports particulate pollution levels and health recommendations for any city or zip code. Look up PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations to check current air conditions; paid plans add ozone, toxic gases, and EPA index scores.

params.name: city
params.description: The city name for which you want to get the air quality data (e.g., New York)

anagramdetector.title: Anagram Detector
anagramdetector.description: Anagram Detector checks whether two words or phrases are anagrams of each other. Submit two strings to receive a true or false match verdict, cleaned comparison text, and character counts with options to ignore letter case and spaces.

params.name: text1
params.description: The first text to compare

params.name: text2
params.description: The second text to compare

params.name: ignorecase
params.description: Ignore case when comparing (default: true)

params.name: ignorespaces
params.description: Ignore spaces when comparing (default: true)

anagrampuzzle.title: Anagram Puzzle Generator
anagrampuzzle.description: Anagram Puzzle Generator creates word puzzles where players rearrange scrambled letters to form valid words, with optional hints.

params.name: word
params.description: Specific word to create anagram for

params.name: count
params.description: Number of puzzles

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty level

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

antonym.title: Antonym Finder
antonym.description: Antonym Finder is an antonym lookup API that finds words with opposite meanings along with their parts of speech across supported languages. Pass any term and an optional language code to receive an array of antonyms.

params.name: word
params.description: The word to get the antonyms for

params.name: language
params.description: Language to return the antonyms in. Defaults to English

articleideas.title: Article Ideas Generator
articleideas.description: Article Ideas Generator creates article ideas and headline angles for any supplied topic. Pass a keyword up to 50 characters to receive a list of suggested titles and the total idea count.

params.name: topic
params.description: The topic for which you want to generate article ideas (up to 50 characters)

ascii85encoder.title: ASCII85 Encoder
ascii85encoder.description: ASCII85 Encoder encodes text into Base85 strings or decodes existing ASCII85 payloads back to plain text. Each request returns the converted output with original and processed character counts, while paid plans add custom formats and compression ratios.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to encode

params.name: action
params.description: Action to perform

params.name: format
params.description: Output format

asnlookup.title: ASN Lookup
asnlookup.description: ASN Lookup resolves any Autonomous System Number to its registered organization name and numeric identifier. Paid plans add the registry handle, country code, and announced IP range statistics.

params.name: asn
params.description: The ASN you want to get information about

babynamegenerator.title: Baby Name Generator
babynamegenerator.description: Baby Name Generator suggests first and middle name combinations for boys and girls based on a selected gender. Paid plans can request multiple names at once and include child avatar images.

params.name: gender
params.description: The gender for the generated names

params.name: count
params.description: The number of names to generate

params.name: includeAvatar
params.description: Include an AI-generated child face avatar matching gender

backgroundremover.title: Background Remover
backgroundremover.description: Background Remover is an image background removal API. Upload a photo or send its URL and it returns a PNG with the background made transparent, or replaced with a solid color you choose.

params.name: bgColor
params.description: Optional hex color to fill the background with (e.g. #ffffff). Omit for a transparent background.

balancesheet.title: Balance Sheet
balancesheet.description: Balance Sheet is a stock balance sheet API that returns the statement of financial position for a US public company by ticker - assets, liabilities and shareholders' equity - straight from SEC filings: current assets, cash, receivables, current liabilities, equity and more. Paid plans add total assets and liabilities, long-term debt, and liquidity and leverage ratios like current ratio, quick ratio and debt-to-equity.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ADBE)

params.name: year
params.description: Fiscal year to retrieve. Defaults to latest available. History covers only the quarters captured so far; a missing period answers 404 listing the available ones.

params.name: quarter
params.description: Fiscal quarter to retrieve. Defaults to latest available.

barcodegenerator.title: Barcode Generator
barcodegenerator.description: Barcode Generator creates downloadable barcode images from text or product codes in Code 128 or Code 39 formats. Each response provides a temporary image download link, file format, and expiration timestamp.

params.name: data
params.description: The data you want to generate a barcode from (string)

params.name: type
params.description: The type of barcode you want to generate

params.name: lineColor
params.description: The color of the barcode (default: #000000)

params.name: backgroundColor
params.description: The background color of the barcode (default: #ffffff)

params.name: displayValue
params.description: Whether to display the value below the barcode (default: true)

barcodereader.title: Barcode Reader
barcodereader.description: Barcode Reader decodes 1D barcodes from an uploaded image or an image URL, including EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, ITF, Codabar and GS1 DataBar. It returns the decoded value and the symbology. Paid plans add the GTIN, the barcode's orientation and corners, and every barcode found in the image.

base64.title: Base64 Encoder/Decoder
base64.description: Base64 Encoder/Decoder encodes plain text into Base64 and decodes encoded strings back to readable characters. Submit any string with an encode or decode action to receive the converted output, the original input, and character length.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to encode

params.name: action
params.description: The action to perform

benchmarkrate.title: Benchmark Rate
benchmarkrate.description: Benchmark Rate retrieves current risk-free reference rates across major currencies, covering SOFR, SONIA, ESTR, TONA, and SARON. Pass a rate symbol to receive the latest percentage rate, effective date, currency, region, and daily change direction.

params.name: rate
params.description: The benchmark rate to retrieve

bible.title: Bible
bible.description: Bible retrieves scripture passages and verses across nine public-domain translations, including the modern Berean Standard Bible (BSB), KJV, ASV, YLT and Darby. Supply a book, chapter, and optional verse number to get the text with testament classification, word count, and chapter totals.

params.name: book
params.description: The name of the book in the bible (e.g., Genesis)

params.name: version
params.description: The Bible translation version

params.name: chapter
params.description: The chapter number in the book

params.name: verse
params.description: The verse number in the chapter

bimivalidator.title: BIMI Record Validator
bimivalidator.description: BIMI Validator checks if a domain has a valid BIMI record published in DNS. BIMI enables domain owners to display verified logos in supported email clients.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain to validate the BIMI record for

bingocardgenerator.title: Bingo Card Generator
bingocardgenerator.description: Bingo Card Generator is a bingo API that creates customizable bingo cards with random numbers as JSON, with HTML rendering and downloadable PNG images on paid plans.

params.name: size
params.description: Card size (3x3 to 10x10)

params.name: freeSpace
params.description: Include free space in center

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable bingo card image

binlookup.title: BIN Lookup
binlookup.description: BIN Lookup is a BIN checker API: send the first 6 to 8 digits of a payment card and get the card brand, type (debit or credit), issuing bank and country of issuance back as JSON. Check incoming cards at checkout before you charge them.

params.name: bin
params.description: The first six digits of the credit card number (BIN)

birthchart.title: Birth Chart
birthchart.description: Birth Chart calculates a tropical natal chart from a birth date, time and location. It returns the sun, moon and rising signs, the ascendant and midheaven, and each planet's sign, degree and retrograde flag. Paid plans add the 12 house cusps, each planet's house, the major aspects and the element and modality balance.

params.name: date
params.description: The birth date (YYYY-MM-DD or MM-DD-YYYY), between 1700 and 2200

params.name: time
params.description: The local birth time in 24-hour HH:mm format

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude of the birthplace

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude of the birthplace (east positive)

params.name: timezone
params.description: An IANA timezone name (America/New_York) or a UTC offset (+05:30). Looked up from the coordinates when omitted

params.name: houseSystem
params.description: The house system to use

birthstones.title: Birthstones
birthstones.description: Birthstones is a comprehensive lookup API for birthstone information. It returns detailed data about gemstones associated with each birth month, including the primary stone, alternate stones, colors, meanings, and zodiac associations.

params.name: month
params.description: The month number (1-12) or name

bitcoin.title: Bitcoin Price
bitcoin.description: Bitcoin Price fetches the current Bitcoin price, recent movement direction, and update timestamps in USD. Paid plans can quote across 172 currencies and add 24-hour volume, market cap, and hourly history.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency to get the price in

params.name: hourly
params.description: Include hourly price data for the past 24 hours

bluetoothlookup.title: Bluetooth Company Lookup
bluetoothlookup.description: Bluetooth Company Lookup allows you to identify Bluetooth device manufacturers by their Bluetooth SIG assigned company identifier. This helps identify the manufacturer of Bluetooth devices, beacons, and accessories.

params.name: companyid
params.description: The Bluetooth SIG company identifier (decimal or hex with 0x prefix). For example, 76 or 0x4C for Apple.

bmicalculator.title: BMI Calculator
bmicalculator.description: BMI Calculator computes Body Mass Index along with ideal weight ranges, BMR (Basal Metabolic Rate), TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure), calorie targets, and macronutrient recommendations for fitness and health applications.

params.name: weight
params.description: Weight in kg (metric) or lbs (imperial)

params.name: height
params.description: Height in cm (metric) or inches (imperial)

params.name: unit
params.description: Unit system for weight and height

params.name: age
params.description: Age in years (required for BMR/TDEE calculations)

params.name: gender
params.description: Gender (required for BMR/TDEE calculations)

params.name: activityLevel
params.description: Activity level (required for TDEE/calorie calculations)

boggleboardgenerator.title: Boggle Board Generator
boggleboardgenerator.description: Boggle Board Generator creates random Boggle game boards with authentic dice configurations, HTML rendering, and downloadable PNG images.

params.name: size
params.description: Board size

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable board image

botdetector.title: Bot Detector
botdetector.description: Bot Detector analyzes user agent strings to identify bots, crawlers, and automated software. It matches against a database of known bots and adds heuristics that catch automated clients not in the database, returning the bot's category, reputation and a composite risk score. Useful for security, analytics, and access control.

params.name: ua
params.description: The user agent string to analyze (URL encoded)

params.name: ip
params.description: Optional IP the request came from. When the user agent claims to be a Google, Bing, OpenAI or Apple crawler, it is checked against that operator's published IP ranges

bucketlist.title: Bucket List
bucketlist.description: Bucket List supplies a random bucket list idea for life goals, travel aspirations, and personal adventures. Call the endpoint with no parameters to receive a single activity suggestion.

caaparser.title: CAA Record Parser
caaparser.description: CAA Record Parser analyzes DNS CAA records that specify which Certificate Authorities are authorized to issue certificates for a domain.

params.name: record
params.description: The CAA record string to parse

callingcode.title: Country Calling Code
callingcode.description: Country Calling Code is a phone number country code API that looks up international dialing codes and official names from a two-letter ISO country code. It returns an array of calling prefixes and standard country identifiers.

params.name: country
params.description: The 2 letter ISO code for the country (e.g. FR)

captchagenerator.title: Captcha Generator
captchagenerator.description: Captcha Generator generates visual captcha challenges with signed image URLs and text solutions. Each request delivers a challenge image, its correct answer string, an expiration timestamp, and a unique identifier.

carddeckshuffler.title: Card Deck Shuffler
carddeckshuffler.description: Card Deck Shuffler randomizes standard playing card decks using Fisher-Yates or riffle algorithms. Pass the deck count and optional jokers to get the full ordered cards with rank, suit, shorthand symbols, and the top card.

params.name: decks
params.description: Number of decks to shuffle

params.name: jokers
params.description: Include jokers in the deck

params.name: method
params.description: Shuffling method

cardgenerator.title: Test Card Generator
cardgenerator.description: Test Card Generator creates card numbers that pass format and checksum validation, for testing checkout forms and payment UIs across major networks. They aren't real cards: no bank issued them, and they can't be charged or used to buy anything. Specify a brand to receive card numbers, security codes, expiration dates, issuers, and masked strings.

params.name: brand
params.description: The brand of the card to generate

params.name: count
params.description: The number of test card numbers to generate

params.name: includeAvatar
params.description: Include an AI-generated face avatar for the card owner

cardvalidator.title: Card Validator
cardvalidator.description: Card Validator is a credit card number validator API: it checks whether a card number is valid, identifies the card brand, and flags risk. It runs the Luhn checksum, detects the scheme (Visa, Mastercard, Amex and more), returns the PCI-safe BIN and last 4 digits, flags known processor test cards, and returns a composite risk score.

params.name: number
params.description: The card number to validate

carmodels.title: US Car Models
carmodels.description: US Car Models is a car make and model API for vehicles sold in the United States from 1984 to present. List models by make on any plan, while paid plans add year filters, trims, fuel economy (MPG), engine details, and transmission specifications.

params.name: make
params.description: The make (manufacturer) of the car (e.g., Toyota, Honda, Ford)

params.name: year
params.description: Filter by year (1984-present)

params.name: model
params.description: Narrow to a model name (e.g., Camry)

params.name: trim
params.description: Narrow to a trim level (e.g., Hybrid)

cashflow.title: Cash Flow Statement
cashflow.description: Cash Flow Statement returns operating, investing and financing cash flows for a US public company by ticker - straight from SEC filings, with free cash flow, FCF margin and cash-conversion metrics calculated for you.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ADBE)

params.name: year
params.description: Fiscal year to retrieve. Defaults to latest available. History covers only the quarters captured so far; a missing period answers 404 listing the available ones.

params.name: quarter
params.description: Fiscal quarter to retrieve. Defaults to latest available.

charades.title: Charades Generator
charades.description: Charades Generator provides random words from curated categories perfect for playing the classic charades acting game.

params.name: category
params.description: Category: all, movies, books, songs, actions, animals, objects

chartgenerator.title: Chart Generator
chartgenerator.description: Chart Generator is a chart API that turns your data into chart and graph images. Supports bar, line, pie, doughnut, radar, and polar area charts with customizable styling.

params.name: type
params.description: Chart type

params.name: labels
params.description: Array of labels for the x-axis or chart segments

params.name: datasets
params.description: Array of datasets with 'name' and 'values'

params.name: title
params.description: Optional title displayed on the chart

params.name: width
params.description: Image width in pixels

params.name: height
params.description: Image height in pixels

params.name: format
params.description: Output format

chessmovevalidator.title: Chess Move Validator
chessmovevalidator.description: Chess Move Validator verifies algebraic chess notation and identifies move types including castling, captures, checks, and promotions.

params.name: move
params.description: Chess move in algebraic notation

chinesezodiac.title: Chinese Zodiac
chinesezodiac.description: Chinese Zodiac returns the zodiac animal, element, and characteristics for any birth date. Accurately accounts for the Chinese lunar calendar - the zodiac year starts on Chinese New Year, not January 1st.

params.name: date
params.description: The date in YYYY-MM-DD format (years 1900-2100)

chucknorris.title: Chuck Norris Jokes
chucknorris.description: Chuck Norris Jokes delivers a random Chuck Norris joke on every request without requiring any query parameters. Each call returns plain joke text ready to display in bots, command-line interfaces, or entertainment feeds.

citieslookup.title: Cities Lookup
citieslookup.description: Cities Lookup is a city search API that searches over 150,000 global cities to find country codes, population counts, and city size classifications by name. Paid plans add GeoJSON coordinates and custom match limits.

params.name: city
params.description: The city name for which you want to get the data (e.g., New York)

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit number of cities that match your search criteria

cocktail.title: Cocktail Recipe
cocktail.description: Cocktail Recipe retrieves cocktail recipes by drink name or ingredient, providing measured ingredients, preparation instructions, and recommended glassware. Responses include serving categories and ingredient counts, with support for pulling random drinks.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the cocktail for which you want to get the recipe (e.g., martini)

codedetector.title: Code Detector
codedetector.description: Code Detector identifies the programming language of any submitted code snippet. It returns the canonical language name, readable title, and standard file extension for the detected code.

params.name: code
params.description: The code snippet you want to detect the programming language of

coinflipper.title: Coin Flipper
coinflipper.description: Coin Flipper simulates random coin flips and records heads or tails outcomes with flip counts. Paid plans can simulate multiple flips per request and calculate percentages, streak lengths, and fairness indicators.

params.name: flips
params.description: Number of coins to flip

colorbrightness.title: Color Brightness Calculator
colorbrightness.description: Color Brightness Calculator checks hex color brightness to classify values as light, dark, or medium, returning RGB components. Paid plans add WCAG contrast ratios, luminance scores, and recommended text colors.

params.name: hex
params.description: Hex color value (with or without # prefix)

colorconverter.title: Color Converter
colorconverter.description: Color Converter translates color values across hex, RGB, CMYK, and named inputs into standard RGB formats and channel breakdowns. Paid plans expand output to include CMYK, HSL, ANSI 16-color codes, and recognized English color names.

params.name: hex
params.description: The color in hexadecimal format (e.g., FF0000). Make sure you ommit the #

colornamefinder.title: Color Name Finder
colornamefinder.description: Color Name Finder matches any hex color code to its closest named CSS color. Send a hex value to get the matching color name, RGB coordinates, and an exact match flag.

params.name: hex
params.description: Hex color value (with or without # prefix)

params.name: closest
params.description: Number of closest color matches to return

colorpalette.title: Color Palette Generator
colorpalette.description: Color Palette Generator produces harmonious color schemes from any HEX base color. It returns color codes in HEX and RGB formats, naming matches, dark-mode flags, and recommended text colors.

params.name: color
params.description: The base color to generate the palette from (HEX format without #)

params.name: scheme
params.description: The color scheme type

params.name: variation
params.description: The color variation

params.name: count
params.description: Caps how many colors are returned (1-16). Each scheme has its own ceiling and count cannot raise it - mono yields 4, contrast 8, triade and analogic 12, tetrade 16. The colorCount field reports how many were actually returned. Free tier limited to 5 colors

params.name: distance
params.description: Color spacing distance (0-1). Affects triade, tetrade, and analogic schemes

params.name: addComplement
params.description: Add complement color to analogic scheme

params.name: webSafe
params.description: Return web-safe colors only

colorsimilarity.title: Color Similarity Calculator
colorsimilarity.description: Color Similarity Calculator measures color similarity between two hex values. It returns an overall similarity score, a categorical match rating, and RGB and HSL channel breakdowns, while paid plans add Delta E and color distance metrics.

params.name: color1
params.description: First hex color value (with or without # prefix)

params.name: color2
params.description: Second hex color value (with or without # prefix)

commentgenerator.title: Comment Generator
commentgenerator.description: Comment Generator produces social media comments formatted for text or image posts across positive, negative, and neutral tones. Each request returns generated comment text with optional emoji support, while paid plans can request batches up to 10.

params.name: mode
params.description: The mode of comment generation

params.name: tone
params.description: The tone of the comments

params.name: count
params.description: The number of comments to generate (max 10)

params.name: emojis
params.description: Whether to include emojis in the comments

companylookup.title: Company Lookup
companylookup.description: Company Lookup matches stock tickers, CIK numbers, company names, or SIC codes with official SEC registration records. It returns legal entity names, trading exchanges, tax EINs, Standard Industrial Classification codes, and registered business addresses.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)

companynamegenerator.title: Company Name Generator
companynamegenerator.description: Company Name Generator generates business name ideas from a seed keyword, returning a list of suggested brand names. Supply any industry or concept word to receive ready-made brand naming suggestions.

params.name: keyword
params.description: The keyword to generate company names from

params.name: count
params.description: The number of company names to generate

compliments.title: Compliment Generator
compliments.description: Compliment Generator creates unique, heartfelt compliments using template-based generation with extensive word banks. Perfect for apps, chatbots, or spreading positivity.

params.name: adult
params.description: Include flirty/romantic compliments

contactextractor.title: Contact Extractor
contactextractor.description: Contact Extractor scrapes public email addresses, phone numbers, and physical addresses from any web page URL. It tallies the findings and returns unique records found on the page.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to extract contact data from

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of found contact details found on the page. Set -1 for unlimited

contentfilter.title: Content Filter
contentfilter.description: Content Filter checks URLs against a comprehensive blocklist of 200,000+ domains categorized as ads-malware, fake news, gambling, adult content, or social media. Returns the specific category for blocked domains, plus every category a domain appears in across a 1.7M-domain index.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL or domain to check

coordinatesaresea.title: Coordinates Are Sea
coordinatesaresea.description: Coordinates Are Sea checks whether a given latitude and longitude pair sits in the ocean or on land. Pass geographic coordinates to receive a boolean confirming if the location is in the sea.

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude of the coordinates

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude of the coordinates

costliving.title: Cost of Living
costliving.description: Cost of Living is a cost of living API that provides index values for US regions based on major metropolitan area data. Compare the relative cost of living between states or cities, each mapped to its Census region, and calculate salary equivalents for relocation decisions on paid plans.

params.name: location
params.description: State name, state code (e.g., CA, NY), or major city name.

counter.title: Cloud Counter
counter.description: Cloud Counter stores and updates persistent numeric counters by ID without needing a database. It tracks increments, decrements, and custom values while returning timestamps and number properties like parity and prime status.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the counter (e.g., test_counter)

countryborders.title: Country Borders
countryborders.description: Country Borders identifies adjacent nations by two-letter ISO country code. It returns the list of bordering countries along with region, subregion, and landlocked status.

params.name: country
params.description: The Country 2 Letter ISO code (e.g., CA)

countryboundaries.title: Country Boundaries
countryboundaries.description: Country Boundaries retrieves GeoJSON border outlines for any country by its two-letter ISO code. Each response includes the country name, geometry type, and boundary coordinate pairs ready for mapping layers.

params.name: country
params.description: The Country 2 Letter ISO code (e.g., CA)

countryflags.title: Country Flags
countryflags.description: Country Flags is a country flag API that fetches direct download URLs for national flag images using two-letter ISO country codes. Responses return the country name, ISO code, and image link, while paid plans can select SVG or PNG formats and shapes.

params.name: country
params.description: The 2 letter ISO Country Code (e.g. ZW)

params.name: format
params.description: The format of the flag image. Optional; defaults to png.

params.name: shape
params.description: The shape of the flag image: rectangle (official proportions), square (1:1 icon) or circle (round 1:1 icon). Optional; defaults to rectangle.

countrylanguages.title: Country Languages
countrylanguages.description: Country Languages lists official and commonly spoken languages for any country using its two-letter ISO code. It returns the common country name, formal official name, an array of recognized languages, and the total language count.

params.name: country
params.description: The Country 2 letter ISO code for which you want to get languages for data (e.g., ZW)

countrylookup.title: Country Lookup
countrylookup.description: Country Lookup matches any country name or ISO code to its official names, ISO 3166 codes, capitals, region, languages, and flag emoji. Paid plans add coordinates and major cities.

params.name: country
params.description: The Country name or ISO code of the country for which you want to get the data (e.g., USA)

params.name: majorcities

countydata.title: County Data Lookup

Pass a sign name to receive today's forecast text; paid tiers add birthdate lookups, mood, lucky numbers, sign compatibility, and sign facts like the ruling planet, opposite sign, brightest star and days until the sign's season.

params.name: sign
params.description: The zodiac sign for which you want to get the horoscope

htmlentities.title: HTML Entities Encoder/Decoder
htmlentities.description: HTML Entities Encoder/Decoder converts special characters into safe HTML entities or restores encoded strings back to standard text. Pass any HTML markup or text snippet to receive the converted string, a replacement count, and a list of modified characters.

params.name: html
params.description: The HTML content to encode

params.name: action
params.description: The action to perform

htmltoimage.title: HTML to Image
htmltoimage.description: HTML to Image is an HTML to image API that renders HTML code into a high-quality PNG image. Paid plans add custom dimensions and JPEG or WebP output.

params.name: html
params.description: HTML code to convert

params.name: width
params.description: Image width in pixels

params.name: height
params.description: Image height in pixels

params.name: format
params.description: Output image format

htmltopdf.title: HTML to PDF
htmltopdf.description: This HTML to PDF API renders raw HTML markup into downloadable PDF files. Send your escaped HTML string to receive a signed download link, an expiration timestamp, and the generated document filename.

params.name: html
params.description: The HTML content to convert to PDF. Ensure that the HTML is escaped properly

params.name: marginTop
params.description: The top margin of the PDF in inches (e.g., 0.5)

params.name: marginRight
params.description: The right margin of the PDF in inches (e.g., 0.5)

params.name: marginBottom
params.description: The bottom margin of the PDF in inches (e.g., 0.5)

params.name: marginLeft
params.description: The left margin of the PDF in inches (e.g., 0.5)

params.name: landscape
params.description: Set to true for landscape orientation

htmltotext.title: HTML to Text
htmltotext.description: HTML to Text extracts clean plain text from raw HTML markup, reporting word counts and character counts. It identifies main article bodies automatically, records the extraction method used, and notes whether parsing succeeded.

params.name: html
params.description: The HTML to convert to text

httpstatuslookup.title: HTTP Status Code Lookup
httpstatuslookup.description: HTTP Status Code Lookup decodes any HTTP status code by returning its standard name and detailed description. Provide a numeric code to inspect its meaning and response behavior across standard ranges.

params.name: code
params.description: HTTP status code to lookup

humannameparser.title: Human Name Parser
humannameparser.description: Human Name Parser splits full name strings into first, middle, and last names, titles, nicknames, and suffixes. It also generates initials directly from the detected components.

params.name: name
params.description: The human name to parse
params.example: MR. MARTINO PETROS DE FLORENCE (TINO) Jr.

ibanvalidator.title: IBAN Validator
ibanvalidator.description: IBAN Validator checks an IBAN's mod-97 checksum, its length and format for the country, and national check digits where the country defines them. It returns whether the IBAN is valid, the country and the reasons it fails. Paid plans add the bank code, branch code and account number, the correct check digits and the SEPA flag.

params.name: iban
params.description: The IBAN to validate. Spaces, dashes and lower case are accepted

ifsclookup.title: IFSC Lookup
ifsclookup.description: IFSC Lookup is an IFSC code search API that verifies Indian bank branch details from any IFSC code, returning the bank name, branch, street address, city, district and state, plus the state's ISO code and the bank and branch codes. Paid plans add MICR, SWIFT and the NEFT, RTGS, IMPS and UPI flags.

params.name: ifsc
params.description: The IFSC code to get information about

imagecaption.title: Image Caption
imagecaption.description: Image Caption generates natural language descriptions for uploaded image files. Upload a JPG, PNG, or GIF up to 5MB to receive an automated caption for alt text and media tagging.

imageconverter.title: Image Converter
imageconverter.description: Image Converter transforms images between formats. Convert HEIC from iPhones, modern WebP and AVIF formats, or classic PNG, JPG, GIF, and TIFF. Includes optional resizing and quality control.

params.name: outputFormat
params.description: Target format

params.name: quality
params.description: Output quality (applies to jpg/webp)

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: Maximum width in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: Maximum height in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

imagetotext.title: Image to Text
imagetotext.description: Image to Text is an OCR and image to text API that extracts text from image files or remote image URLs using optical character recognition. Upload a JPG, PNG, or GIF up to 5 MB to receive the raw extracted text.

imeigenerator.title: IMEI Generator
imeigenerator.description: IMEI Generator creates valid International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI) numbers with proper Luhn checksum validation for mobile devices.

params.name: brand
params.description: Filter by manufacturer brand (e.g., Samsung, Apple, Nokia)

params.name: count
params.description: Number of IMEIs to generate

incomestatement.title: Income Statement
incomestatement.description: Income Statement returns the profit and loss statement for a US public company by ticker - revenue, cost of revenue, gross profit, operating income and net income - straight from SEC filings, with gross, operating and net margins and year-over-year growth calculated for you.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ADBE)

params.name: year
params.description: Fiscal year to retrieve. Defaults to latest available. History covers only the quarters captured so far; a missing period answers 404 listing the available ones.

params.name: quarter
params.description: Fiscal quarter to retrieve. Defaults to latest available.

incometax.title: Income Tax Brackets
incometax.description: Income Tax Brackets retrieves federal income tax brackets, marginal rates, and standard deductions across all US filing statuses. Paid plans can query specific historical tax years back to 2000.

params.name: country
params.description: The country code (currently only 'US' is supported)

params.name: year
params.description: The tax year to retrieve brackets for. Defaults to the previous year.

incometaxcalculator.title: Income Tax Calculator
incometaxcalculator.description: Income Tax Calculator computes US federal income tax and take-home pay from gross income and filing status. It outputs total tax owed, effective and marginal rates, standard deductions, and net monthly income.

params.name: income
params.description: Gross annual income in USD

params.name: rate
params.description: Tax rate as a percentage (e.g., 22 for 22%)

params.name: deduction
params.description: Optional deduction amount to subtract from income before calculating tax

inflation.title: Inflation Rate
inflation.description: Inflation Rate reports annual inflation rates and Consumer Price Index (CPI) values for any country by two-letter country code. Outputs include the year-over-year price change percentage, CPI index, and base comparison year, with paid plans supporting historical lookups by year.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 2-letter country code (e.g., US, GB, JP, DE, BR)

params.name: year
params.description: The year to retrieve data for. Defaults to the previous year.

initialismgenerator.title: Initialism Generator
initialismgenerator.description: Initialism Generator creates initialisms from phrases by extracting first letters of significant words, with options for filtering and formatting.

params.name: phrase
params.description: Phrase to convert to initialism (max 500 characters)

params.name: excludeCommonWords
params.description: Exclude common words like 'the', 'of', 'and'

params.name: uppercase
params.description: Return the initialism in uppercase

insidertrading.title: Insider Trading
insidertrading.description: Insider Trading returns recent SEC Form 4 insider transactions for a US public company by ticker - who bought or sold, their role, the number of shares, price and transaction type - plus a derived insider-sentiment summary with net buy/sell activity and cluster-buy detection calculated for you.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ADBE)

params.name: type
params.description: Filter to open-market buys or sells (buy or sell).

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of transactions to return (1-25). Defaults to 5.

interestrate.title: Interest Rate
interestrate.description: Interest Rate retrieves central bank policy rates for 22 major economies by country code. It delivers the latest interest rate percentage, central bank name, recorded date, and whether the rate moved up, down, or remained unchanged.

params.name: country
params.description: 2-letter country code

params.name: date
params.description: Optional month in YYYY-MM format for a historical lookup. Omit for the current rate.

invoicegenerator.title: Invoice Generator
invoicegenerator.description: Invoice Generator is an invoice generation API that creates downloadable PDF invoices from party addresses, line items, and payment terms. It computes subtotals with discounts and sales tax, returning an expiring download link.

params.name: invoiceNumber
params.description: The invoice number

params.name: date
params.description: The invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD format)

params.name: from_name
params.description: The name of the person or company issuing the invoice

params.name: from_street
params.description: The street address of the person or company issuing the invoice

params.name: from_city
params.description: The city of the person or company issuing the invoice

params.name: from_state
params.description: The state of the person or company issuing the invoice

params.description: The zip code of the person or company issuing the invoice

params.description: The street address of the person or company being invoiced

params.name: to_city
params.description: The city of the person or company being invoiced

params.name: to_state
params.description: The state of the person or company being invoiced

params.name: to_zip
params.description: The zip code of the person or company being invoiced

params.name: paymentTerms
params.description: The payment terms for the invoice

params.name: dueDate
params.description: The due date for the invoice (YYYY-MM-DD format)

params.name: discount
params.description: The discount to be applied to the invoice

params.name: salesTax
params.description: The sales tax rate for the invoice as a percentage, applied to the subtotal after discount (e.g. 7.5 for 7.5%)

params.name: logoURL
params.description: Public http(s) URL of an image to use as the invoice logo (max 2 MB, fetched with a 5 second timeout; a placeholder logo is used if it can't be loaded)

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency for the invoice

params.name: items
params.description: The items being invoiced (qty, description, unit_price)

ipblacklistlookup.title: IP Blacklist Lookup
ipblacklistlookup.description: IP Blacklist Lookup is an IP blacklist check API that tells you whether a given IP address appears on known malicious IP blocklists. Identifies both inbound threats (attackers, spammers) and outbound threats (C2 servers, malware hosts).

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address to check against blocklists

ipdemographics.title: IP Demographics
ipdemographics.description: IP Demographics combines IP geolocation with Census demographic data to provide demographic information for any IP address. Get location, income, education, and housing data based on the IP's geographic location. Demographics cover US ZIP codes; other locations return the location with demographics set to null.

params.name: ip
params.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address

iplookup.title: IP Lookup
iplookup.description: IP Lookup is an IP address location API that resolves any IP to its country, region, timezone and continent. Paid plans add city, coordinates, postal code, an accuracy radius and an EU-membership flag for compliance routing.

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address for which you want to get the location data (e.g., 173.172.81.20)

isbnvalidator.title: ISBN Validator
isbnvalidator.description: ISBN Validator checks ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 numbers for valid checksums and parses their registration group, publisher, and title parts. Pass any raw book identifier with or without hyphens to inspect normalized digits, format type, and specific rejection reasons.

params.name: isbn
params.description: The ISBN number to validate (ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, with or without separators)

jobpostings.title: Job Postings
jobpostings.description: Job Postings is a jobs API that returns the open positions on a company's public career board. Every job comes back in the same shape: title, department, team, locations, remote and workplace type, employment type, posting date and apply link. Filter by keyword, location, department, employment type, posting date or remote. Paid plans add the full job description and salary ranges where the company publishes them.

params.name: company
params.description: The company's career board name, usually the company name in lowercase, for example airbnb, stripe or palantir. Required unless url is given.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Return only jobs whose title, department or team contains every word given, for example engineer or product designer.

params.name: location
params.description: Return only jobs with a location containing this text, for example London, New York or Germany.

params.name: remote
params.description: true returns only jobs open to remote work; false only jobs that are not.

params.name: department
params.description: Return only jobs whose department or team contains this text, for example Engineering or Sales.

params.name: employmentType
params.description: Return only jobs of this employment type. Jobs whose board gives no employment type are kept, since many boards leave it blank; only jobs of another type are left out.

params.name: postedSince
params.description: Return only jobs first published at or after this date or date-time (ISO 8601, for example 2026-10-01), or within this age: a number followed by h, d or w, for example 12h, 7d or 2w. Jobs with no posting date are left out when this is set.

params.name: minSalary
params.description: Return only jobs whose salary range reaches at least this amount, in the job's own currency and pay period: the top of the range is compared, or the bottom when no top is given. Jobs that publish no salary are left out when this is set.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results to return: 10 jobs per page on the free plan, 50 on paid plans.

jobsearch.title: Job Search
jobsearch.description: Job Search is a jobs API that searches the open positions at thousands of companies at once. Search by job title keywords, location, country, remote work, employment type, posting date or company, and get the newest matching jobs first, each with its title, company, location, country, workplace type, posting date and apply link. Paid plans add salary ranges, a minimum salary filter, larger pages and each job's full description.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Words that must all appear in the job title, for example data engineer or product designer.

params.name: location
params.description: Return only jobs with a location containing this text, for example London, New York or Bavaria.

params.name: country
params.description: Return only jobs in this country: an ISO 3166 code or a name, for example US, GB or Germany.

params.name: remote
params.description: true returns only jobs open to remote work; false only jobs that are not.

params.name: employmentType
params.description: Return only jobs of this employment type. Jobs that give no employment type are kept, since many companies leave it blank; only jobs of another type are left out.

params.name: postedSince
params.description: Return only jobs first published at or after this date or date-time (ISO 8601, for example 2026-10-01), or within this age: a number followed by h, d or w, for example 12h, 7d or 2w.

params.name: company
params.description: Return only jobs at this company, by its career board name, usually the company name in lowercase, for example airbnb.

params.name: minSalary
params.description: Return only jobs whose salary range reaches at least this amount, in the job's own currency and pay period. Jobs that publish no salary are left out when this is set.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results: 10 jobs per page up to page 5 on the free plan, 50 per page up to page 10 on paid plans.

jobsreport.title: Jobs Report
jobsreport.description: Jobs Report provides monthly US employment data including unemployment rate, total employment, labor force participation, and employment by industry sector. The same data released in the monthly BLS jobs report.

params.name: date
params.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM format for historical lookup. Omit for current data.

jsonschemagenerator.title: JSON Schema Generator
jsonschemagenerator.description: JSON Schema Generator is a JSON to JSON Schema API: it inspects sample JSON payloads and generates Draft-07 JSON Schema definitions with inferred types and property formats. It identifies formats like emails and dates, applies custom titles, and lists all properties as required.

params.name: json
params.description: The sample JSON data to generate a schema from

params.name: title
params.description: The title for the generated schema (default: 'Generated Schema')

params.name: description
params.description: Optional description for the schema

jsonschemavalidator.title: JSON Schema Validator
jsonschemavalidator.description: JSON Schema Validator is a JSON validator API that tests any JSON object against a JSON Schema you provide, so you can check JSON against its schema before trusting it. It reports pass-fail status and total error count, while paid plans add specific error messages.

params.name: schema
params.description: The JSON Schema to validate against

params.name: json
params.description: The JSON data to validate. An empty object is a valid document and is accepted.

jsontocsv.title: JSON to CSV Converter
jsontocsv.description: JSON to CSV Converter converts an array of JSON objects into structured CSV text. It outputs formatted CSV content, detected column headers, and row counts, with support for custom delimiters like commas, tabs, or pipes.

params.name: json
params.description: The JSON array to convert to CSV (must be array of objects)

params.name: delimiter
params.description: The delimiter to use in the CSV

params.name: include_header
params.description: Whether to include column headers in the output (default: true)

jsontojsonp.title: JSON to JSONP
jsontojsonp.description: JSON to JSONP wraps JSON data in a JavaScript callback function to produce valid JSONP output. Pass an object or JSON string with an optional callback identifier to receive the formatted script string.

params.name: json
params.description: The JSON data you want converted into JSONP format. Send it as an object or as a JSON-encoded string.

params.name: callback
params.description: The callback function name to wrap the JSON data. Must be a JavaScript identifier, optionally dotted (e.g. myCallback or window.myCallback).

julianday.title: Julian Day Calculator
julianday.description: Julian Day Calculator converts between Gregorian calendar dates and Julian Day Numbers (JDN). Julian Day is a continuous count of days used in astronomy and historical research.

params.name: date
params.description: The Gregorian date in YYYY-MM-DD format

jwtdecoder.title: JWT Decoder
jwtdecoder.description: JWT Decoder decodes JWT tokens to reveal header and payload information without performing signature verification. It handles JSON web token decode from any language over REST, so you can inspect claims and expiry without adding a JWT library.

params.name: token
params.description: JWT token to decode

keywordextractor.title: Keyword Extractor
keywordextractor.description: Keyword Extractor is a keyword extraction API that scans raw text or live webpage URLs to extract key terms and their frequencies. It returns up to 50 unique keywords, occurrence counts, total keyword volume, and the top five terms with their percentage share.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to extract keywords from

languagedetector.title: Language Detector
languagedetector.description: Language Detector is a language detection API that identifies the language of any submitted text string. It returns the primary language, its ISO 639-1 code, and candidate matches ranked by confidence scores.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to detect the language of

leetspeak.title: Leet Speak
leetspeak.description: Leet Speak translates plain text into leet speak or reverses obfuscated strings back to standard words. Submit any string with an encode or decode mode to receive the converted text and a count of changed characters.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to encode or decode in Leet Speak

params.name: mode
params.description: The mode to use

lemmatizer.title: Text Lemmatizer
lemmatizer.description: Text Lemmatizer reduces inflected words in submitted text down to their dictionary base forms. It confirms when valid lemmas exist, while paid plans return full word-by-word mappings.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to lemmatize

levenshteindistance.title: Levenshtein Distance
levenshteindistance.description: Levenshtein Distance calculates the minimum number of single-character edits needed to transform one string into another.

params.name: string1

params.name: string2
params.description: Second string to compare (max 10,000 characters)

lexicon.title: Word Lexicon Analyzer
lexicon.description: Word Lexicon Analyzer inspects any single word to check linguistic properties including palindromes, isograms, and Scrabble validity. It identifies anagram potential, alphagram status, and sorted letter forms.

params.name: word
params.description: The word to analyze

linesorter.title: Line Sorter
linesorter.description: Line Sorter organizes text by sorting lines alphabetically in ascending or descending order with case-sensitive options.

params.name: lines
params.description: Array of text lines to sort (max 10,000)

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order

params.name: caseSensitive
params.description: Enable case-sensitive sorting

linkscraper.title: Link Scraper
linkscraper.description: Link Scraper is a website link extractor API that pulls internal and external links from any webpage URL in real time. It resolves relative paths to absolute URLs, strips empty fragments, and returns anchor text with internal and external counts.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to scrape links from

params.name: maxlinks
params.description: Maximum number of links to scrape and return

params.name: includequery
params.description: Include query strings in the scraped links

liturgicalcalendar.title: Liturgical Calendar
liturgicalcalendar.description: Liturgical Calendar retrieves Catholic liturgical calendar events for any given month. It details feast ranks, vestment colors, liturgical seasons, and holy days of obligation, while paid plans add custom year queries.

params.name: month
params.description: The month to get Liturgical Calendar data for (default: current month)

params.name: year
params.description: The year to get Liturgical Calendar data for (default: current year)

loanpaymentcalculator.title: Loan Calculator
loanpaymentcalculator.description: Loan Calculator is a payment calculation API that computes monthly loan payments, total interest, and overall loan costs based on principal, annual interest rate, and term length. Include an optional down payment to determine adjusted financing balances and interest ratios.

params.name: loanAmount
params.description: The loan amount

params.name: interestRate
params.description: The interest rate (percentage)

params.name: loanTerm
params.description: The loan term in years

params.name: downpayment
params.description: Amount paid up front, subtracted from the loan amount before interest is applied

loremipsumgenerator.title: Lorem Ipsum Generator
loremipsumgenerator.description: Lorem Ipsum Generator generates placeholder text by paragraph count with optional length limits and standard opening phrasing. Every response includes the dummy copy plus word and sentence counts.

params.name: paragraphs

params.name: startwithlorem
params.description: Start the text with 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet'

params.name: maxlength
params.description: The maximum length of the generated text (0 for no limit)

lottery.title: Lottery Numbers
lottery.description: Lottery Numbers fetches winning lottery numbers, bonus balls, draw dates, and jackpot amounts for major games. Specify Powerball, Mega Millions, EuroMillions, or Lotto Max to receive draw results with prize totals.

params.name: numbers
params.description: The lottery game to lookup: powerball, megamillions, euromillions, or lottomax

params.name: date
params.description: Optional date for historical lookup (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the nearest draw to this date.

lovecalculator.title: Love Calculator
lovecalculator.description: Love Calculator calculates romantic compatibility between any two names, returning a match percentage and summary text. Paid plans add detailed compatibility advice for the pair.

params.name: name1

params.name: name2

macaddresslookup.title: MAC Address Lookup
macaddresslookup.description: MAC Address Lookup validates any MAC address and converts it across standard colon, dash, dot, and raw hex formats. On paid plans it becomes a MAC vendor lookup API, adding the device hardware vendor and OUI identifier.

madlibs.title: Mad Libs Generator
madlibs.description: Mad Libs Generator is a Mad Libs API that creates fill-in-the-blank story templates with prompts for nouns, verbs, adjectives, and more.

params.name: category
params.description: Story category

params.name: count
params.description: Number of stories

magic8ball.title: Magic 8-Ball
magic8ball.description: Magic 8-Ball is a fun tool that provides random predictions and answers like the classic toy. It returns one of 20 classic Magic 8-Ball responses categorized as affirmative, negative, or non-committal.

params.name: question
params.description: Your question for the Magic 8-Ball (optional)

marineweather.title: Marine Weather
marineweather.description: Marine Weather fetches offshore weather conditions for any marine coordinates by latitude and longitude. Each response details high and low temperatures, maximum wind speeds, precipitation totals, humidity, UV index, and sunrise and sunset times.

params.name: lat

params.name: lon

markdownlinkextractor.title: Markdown Link Extractor
markdownlinkextractor.description: Markdown Link Extractor parses markdown documents and extracts all links including inline, reference, autolinks, and image URLs.

markdowntohtml.title: Markdown to HTML
markdowntohtml.description: Markdown to HTML is a markdown converter API that parses markdown syntax and converts it to clean, semantic HTML suitable for web rendering and content management.

params.name: markdown

markdowntoimage.title: Markdown to Image
markdowntoimage.description: Markdown to Image converts markdown text into visual image representations, rendering content as PNG, JPEG, or WebP images.

markdowntopdf.title: Markdown to PDF

params.name: markdown
params.description: Markdown text to convert (max 100,000 characters)

math.title: Math Calculator

params.name: date
params.description: The Gregorian date in YYYY-MM-DD format

maze.title: Maze Generator
maze.description: Maze Generator creates random mazes using recursive backtracking algorithm with customizable size and difficulty.

params.name: width

meetingtimeconverter.description: Meeting Time Converter transforms meeting times between any two timezones, calculating time differences and UTC offsets for global coordination.

menstrualcycle.title: Menstrual Cycle Calculator

metadataextractor.title: Metadata Extractor

mimetypelookup.title: MIME Type Lookup
mimetypelookup.description: MIME Type Lookup matches file extensions to MIME types, categories, and default character encodings, or returns matching extensions for any media type. Paid plans add gzip compressibility flags.

minimumwage.title: Minimum Wage

moonphases.title: Moon Phases
moonphases.description: Moon Phases calculates the current lunar phase, illumination percentage, and lunar age for today. It reports waxing or waning status, Earth-moon distance, and emoji representations, while paid plans add custom date queries and full moon tracking.

moonposition.description: Moon Position calculates the moon's altitude in the sky for any latitude and longitude coordinates. Provide an optional time of day to determine lunar elevation; paid plans add custom dates, azimuth, and distance.

moonrisemoonset.title: Moonrise Moonset
moonrisemoonset.description: Moonrise Moonset calculates exact moonrise and moonset times for any geographic coordinate. It outputs ISO 8601 timestamps for lunar rise and set events, with paid plans adding moon phase details and date selection.

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude of the location

params.name: lon

params.name: date
params.description: The date to get the moonrise and moonset times for (MM-dd-yyyy)

morsecode.title: Morse Code
morsecode.description: Morse Code is a Morse code translator and decoder API: it converts plain text to Morse code dots and dashes and translates Morse back into text. It provides character counts, dit and dah totals, and validation status, while paid plans add downloadable audio tones.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to encode or decode in Morse code

params.description: Set to true to include an audio file of the Morse code

mortgagecalculator.title: Mortgage Calculator
mortgagecalculator.description: Mortgage Calculator computes monthly and annual loan payments from principal, interest rate, and term. It breaks totals down by principal, interest, property tax, insurance, and HOA dues, with paid plans adding full amortization schedules.

params.description: Month to retrieve rates for (1-12). Required when year is specified.

murmurhash.title: MurmurHash
murmurhash.description: MurmurHash generates fast, non-cryptographic hashes using the MurmurHash3 algorithm. Ideal for hash tables, data partitioning, bloom filters, and checksums where cryptographic security isn't needed.

mxlookup.title: MX Lookup
mxlookup.description: MX Lookup queries DNS to find MX records for any domain. It returns an array of mail exchange hostnames and their priority routing values in real time.

nameservers.title: Nameservers
nameservers.description: Nameservers queries authoritative DNS records for any domain to list its nameservers, IP addresses, and reverse DNS records. It detects multiple DNS providers, counts total nameservers, and identifies who runs each server.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain name to lookup nameservers for

nationaldebt.title: National Debt
nationaldebt.description: National Debt provides real-time access to the US national debt (Debt to the Penny). It returns the total public debt, debt held by the public, intragovernmental holdings, and per-capita debt calculations.

params.name: date

neverhaveiever.title: Never Have I Ever
neverhaveiever.description: Never Have I Ever generates random statements for the popular party game. Features 330+ unique prompts with per-API-key tracking to avoid repeats.

news.title: World News
news.description: World News is a global news API that reads about 275 outlet feeds in 29 editions and 6 languages and merges them into stories: one entry per story however many outlets carry it, ranked by that coverage. params.name: country
params.description: Only stories about this country, from any outlet: an ISO 3166 code or English name, for example JP or Japan.

params.description: Only stories run by outlets based in this country: what its press is covering, in the languages it writes in. See list=editions.

params.description: Only stories in this language. Defaults to English, or with edition to the languages that edition's press writes in. Stories are never translated.

params.description: Only stories whose headlines or summaries contain every word given, in any case.

params.name: since
params.description: Only stories published at or after this date or date-time (ISO 8601), for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T14:00:00Z.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of stories to return: up to 10 on the free plan, 50 on paid plans.

nobelprizes.title: Nobel Prizes
nobelprizes.description: Nobel Prizes searches laureate records by first name, last name, and award category. Each result includes the winner's full name, award year, and category, while paid plans add year filtering, motivations, and biographical details.

params.name: year
params.description: The year of the Nobel Prize to get information about

nsfwimagedetector.title: NSFW Image Detector
nsfwimagedetector.description: NSFW Image Detector scans uploaded photos to determine whether an image contains adult content. Send a JPG, PNG, or GIF file up to 10 MB to receive safe and adult content boolean flags.

numberbaseconverter.title: Number Base Converter
numberbaseconverter.description: Number Base Converter converts numbers between any base from 2 to 36, including binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal. Pass a value with optional source and target bases to receive the converted string, base names, and exact decimal values.

params.name: value
params.description: The number to convert

params.description: Source base (default: 10)

params.name: to
params.description: Target base (returns all common bases if not specified)

numbertowords.title: Number to Words
numbertowords.description: Number to Words is a number to words API that converts numeric values into written cardinal words and counts whole and fractional digits. Pass any integer or float to get the spelled-out text along with digit counts and locale information.

params.name: number
params.description: The number to convert to words

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.description: Nutrition returns the nutrition facts for a generic whole food by name - calories and the core macronutrients per 100 grams straight from the USDA food composition database - plus, on paid plans, a full micronutrient panel and derived nutrition intelligence like calories per gram and the protein, fat and carbohydrate share of calories.

params.name: food
params.description: Name of the food to look up (e.g. banana, chicken breast, olive oil)

params.description: Serving weight in grams to scale the nutrition panel to. Defaults to a per-100-gram basis.

officetopdf.title: Office to PDF
officetopdf.description: Office to PDF converts Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF, text and CSV files to PDF and returns a download link valid for 2 days, with the page count of the result. params.description: Lay the pages out in landscape orientation

openlicenses.title: Open Source Licenses
openlicenses.description: Open Source Licenses is a software license API that looks up open source license details by name or identifier. It returns SPDX identifiers, canonical URLs, OSI approval status, legacy IDs, and domain applicability for software, content, or data.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the open source license to get information about

ovulationcalculator.title: Ovulation Calculator
ovulationcalculator.description: Ovulation Calculator estimates ovulation dates, fertile windows, and provides detailed cycle phase information based on menstrual cycle data.

params.name: last_period
params.description: First day of last menstrual period (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: cycle_length
params.description: Average menstrual cycle length in days

palindromechecker.title: Palindrome Checker
palindromechecker.description: Palindrome Checker tests whether a string reads the same forwards and backwards, with options to ignore casing, spacing, and punctuation. It returns the boolean verdict, the normalized text, the reversed comparison string, and the length of the longest palindromic sequence.

params.description: The text to check for palindrome. Maximum 20000 characters
params.example: A man a plan a canal Panama

params.name: ignorecase
params.description: Ignore case when checking (default: true)

params.name: ignorespaces
params.description: Ignore spaces when checking (default: true)

params.name: ignorepunctuation
params.description: Ignore punctuation when checking (default: true)

palladiumprice.title: Palladium Price
palladiumprice.description: Palladium Price tracks real-time spot rates for palladium per ounce, gram, and kilogram in USD. It supplies 24-hour price changes and update timestamps, while paid plans add custom currencies and 24-hour hourly history.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency to get the price in

params.name: hourly
params.description: Include hourly price data for the past 24 hours

partsofspeech.title: Parts Of Speech
partsofspeech.description: Parts Of Speech extracts words from text based on grammatical categories like nouns, verbs, and adjectives. Pass any text passage and a category to receive an array of matching words.

params.description: The text to extract words from

passwordbreach.title: Password Breach Checker
passwordbreach.description: Password Breach Checker tells you whether a password appears in the Pwned Passwords corpus of passwords exposed in data breaches. Send the password or its SHA-1 hash and get a breached flag. Paid plans add how many times it was seen and a risk level.

params.description: The 40-character hex SHA-1 of the password, instead of the password itself

passwordgenerator.title: Password Generator
passwordgenerator.description: Password Generator creates random passwords, pronounceable strings, and multi-word passphrases configured by length, complexity, and character sets. It outputs generated strings with character counts and configuration metadata.

params.name: complexity

passwordstrength.title: Password Strength

pdfpagenumbers.title: PDF Page Numbers
pdfpagenumbers.description: PDF Page Numbers stamps a page number on every page of a PDF, uploaded or fetched from a URL, and returns a download link to the numbered file. params.name: position

pdftoimage.title: PDF to Image
pdftoimage.description: PDF to Image renders the pages you choose from a PDF, uploaded or fetched from a URL, as PNG or JPG images and returns a download link for each, valid for 2 days, with its pixel size. periodictable.title: Periodic Table
