treasuryyields.title: Treasury Yields
treasuryyields.description: Treasury Yields provides current and historical US Treasury constant-maturity market yields across the full curve (1-month through 30-year), plus TIPS real yields. Essential data for yield curve analysis and fixed income research.

params.name: date
params.description: Optional month in YYYY-MM format for a recent-month lookup (recent months only). Omit for current data.

params.name: type
params.description: Optional filter for a single point. Legacy security types: bills, notes, bonds, tips, frn. Or a maturity: 1mo, 3mo, 6mo, 1yr, 2yr, 3yr, 5yr, 7yr, 10yr, 20yr, 30yr

trivia.title: Trivia Generator
trivia.description: Trivia Generator is a trivia and quiz API that serves random trivia questions complete with multiple-choice options and the correct answer. Paid plans can filter questions across topics like history, science, geography, and pop culture.

params.name: category
params.description: The category of the trivia question

truthordare.title: Truth or Dare
truthordare.description: The Truth or Dare API generates random truth questions and dare challenges for the classic party game. Features 400+ unique prompts with per-API-key tracking to avoid repeats.

params.name: type
params.description: Prompt type: truth, dare, or random

params.name: adult
params.description: Include adult/spicy prompts

truthtable.title: Truth Table Generator
truthtable.description: Truth Table Generator creates complete truth tables for boolean expressions with support for AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, and NOR operators.

params.name: expression
params.description: Boolean expression using A-Z variables and operators (AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, NOR)

ulidgenerator.title: ULID Generator
ulidgenerator.description: ULID Generator creates Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifiers that order records chronologically. Pass an optional batch count and millisecond timestamp to produce 26-character collision-resistant unique IDs with format details.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of ULIDs to generate

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Custom timestamp in milliseconds (optional, uses current time if not specified)

unemployment.title: Unemployment Rate
unemployment.description: Unemployment Rate looks up labor statistics by two- or three-letter ISO country code. It returns the country name, reporting year, and record count, with paid plans adding historical annual rates.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO country code (2 or 3 letter). Examples: US, USA, DE, DEU, GB, GBR

params.name: year
params.description: Specific year to retrieve data for (1991-present). Returns latest if not specified.

unicodeescape.title: Unicode Escape/Unescape
unicodeescape.description: Unicode Escape/Unescape converts text into Unicode escape sequences or restores escaped strings back into readable characters. Send any string to get the transformed text and total character count.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to escape

params.name: action
params.description: The action to perform

unicodelookup.title: Unicode Character Lookup
unicodelookup.description: Unicode Character Lookup is a Unicode lookup API that inspects any character, symbol or hex codepoint to find its decimal value, hex notation, and UTF-16 encoding. The response also identifies the character category and supplies names for emoji.

params.name: character
params.description: The Unicode character to lookup. Supply either character or codepoint.

params.name: codepoint
params.description: The Unicode codepoint in hex (e.g., '1F44B' or 'U+1F44B'). Supply either character or codepoint.

unitconverter.title: Unit Converter
unitconverter.description: Unit Converter converts values between different units of measurement. Pass a numeric value with source and target unit identifiers to get the converted result and unit abbreviations.

params.name: value
params.description: The value to convert

params.name: from
params.description: The unit to convert from

params.name: to
params.description: The unit to convert to

unixtimestamp.title: Unix Timestamp Converter
unixtimestamp.description: Unix Timestamp Converter converts Unix timestamps into formatted dates and parses ISO 8601 strings back into epoch seconds. Responses break down dates into ISO 8601, RFC 2822, simple time strings, and individual calendar components like year, month, and hour.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Unix timestamp to convert

params.name: format
params.description: Timestamp format

urlencode.title: URL Encoder/Decoder
urlencode.description: URL Encoder/Decoder converts text into percent-encoded strings or decodes existing URL components back into plain text. Pass any string with an encode or decode action to receive the processed output and your original text.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to encode

params.name: action
params.description: The action to perform

urllookup.title: URL Lookup
urllookup.description: URL Lookup resolves any web address to its hosting server IP address, country, and continent in real time. Paid plans add city, state, coordinates, timezone, and EU membership status.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL to lookup the location of. Include the https protocol

urltitle.title: URL Title
urltitle.description: URL Title fetches the HTML title tag of any web page in real time from a target URL. Paid plans also retrieve an array of every H1 heading tag found on the page.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to get the title of

urltomarkdown.title: URL to Markdown
urltomarkdown.description: URL to Markdown converts any webpage URL into structured Markdown text. Each response delivers the page title, converted text, word count, and element counts, with paid plans adding optional link and image syntax.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the webpage to convert to Markdown

params.name: includeImages
params.description: Whether to include image references in the Markdown output

params.name: includeLinks
params.description: Whether to include hyperlinks in the Markdown output

urlunshortener.title: URL Unshortener
urlunshortener.description: URL Unshortener expands shortened links to reveal their final destination URL and destination domain. Send any short link to inspect the resolved address and redirect count; paid plans add the full redirect chain.

params.name: url
params.description: The shortened URL to unshorten

usbvendorlookup.title: USB Vendor Lookup
usbvendorlookup.description: USB Vendor Lookup allows you to identify USB device manufacturers and products by their vendor ID and product ID. It uses the Linux USB ID Repository, which contains thousands of USB vendor and product identifiers.

params.name: vendorid
params.description: The USB vendor ID in 4-digit hex format (e.g., 05AC for Apple)

params.name: productid
params.description: The USB product ID in 4-digit hex format (optional)

useragentgenerator.title: User Agent Generator
useragentgenerator.description: User Agent Generator creates realistic user agent strings for desktop, mobile, and tablet devices. Each request outputs the complete string with parsed browser and operating system names and versions, while paid plans add engine and CPU details.

params.name: device
params.description: The device type for the user agent string

useragentparser.title: User Agent Parser
useragentparser.description: User Agent Parser parses user agent strings to extract browser, operating system, and hardware details. It identifies device types, CPU architecture, and bot traffic, so you can run user agent detection on every incoming HTTP request.

params.name: ua
params.description: The user agent string to parse

usernamegenerator.title: Username Generator
usernamegenerator.description: Username Generator creates handle suggestions from a person's name or email address. It returns an array of suggested usernames based on the input, while paid plans can request multiple options at once.

params.name: email
params.description: The email address to generate usernames from

params.name: count
params.description: The number of usernames to generate

usernameprofanity.title: Username Profanity
usernameprofanity.description: Username Profanity flags offensive or inappropriate usernames before they reach your database. Send any candidate handle to receive a clear true or false profanity check result.

params.name: username
params.description: The username to check if it is inappropriate or profane

utmconverter.title: UTM Coordinate Converter
utmconverter.description: UTM Coordinate Converter provides bidirectional conversion between UTM (Universal Transverse Mercator) coordinates and latitude/longitude using WGS84 datum.

params.name: direction
params.description: Conversion direction

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude (-90 to 90)

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude (-180 to 180)

uuidgenerator.title: UUID Generator
uuidgenerator.description: UUID Generator is a UUID generator API that produces random RFC 4122 version 4 UUIDs on demand. Request single IDs or batches in standard lowercase, uppercase, or strings without hyphens.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of UUIDs to generate

params.name: version
params.description: UUID version (only version 4 currently supported)

params.name: format
params.description: Output format

variablenameconverter.title: Variable Name Converter
variablenameconverter.description: Variable Name Converter transforms variable names between different naming conventions including camelCase, snake_case, PascalCase, and kebab-case.

params.name: variables
params.description: Array of variable names to convert (max 100). Every entry must be a string.

params.name: to
params.description: Target naming convention

vatrates.title: VAT Rates
vatrates.description: VAT Rates is a European VAT rates API: send a two-letter country code and get the current VAT rates for that country as JSON, with the full standard, reduced, super-reduced and parking set for EU members plus the UK, and standard rates for non-EU countries such as Switzerland and Norway. Paid plans add historical rates by date and regional exceptions by postcode.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 2-letter country code (e.g., DE, FR, ES)

params.name: date
params.description: Look up rate effective on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.name: postcode
params.description: Check for regional exceptions (e.g., Canary Islands, Ceuta)

vindecoder.title: VIN Decoder
vindecoder.description: VIN Decoder turns a 17-character Vehicle Identification Number into the vehicle it identifies. Returns make, model, year, trim, body class and manufacturer, plus engine specifications, plant of manufacture, and the safety equipment fitted to that specific build. Optionally adds every safety recall issued for that vehicle and its NHTSA 5-star crash-test rating.

params.name: vin
params.description: The Vehicle Identification Number to decode. Partial VINs are accepted and decode as far as the available characters allow.

params.name: recalls
params.description: Add the safety recalls NHTSA has issued for this vehicle's make, model and year.

params.name: safetyRating
params.description: Add the NHTSA 5-star crash-test rating for the closest tested version of this vehicle.

visarequirements.title: Visa Requirements
visarequirements.description: Visa Requirements tells you what a passport holder needs to enter another country: no visa, an electronic travel authorization, an eVisa, a visa on arrival, a visa arranged in advance, or entry restricted. It also returns the allowed stay in days where one is set. Paid plans can list every destination for one passport.

params.name: passport
params.description: The passport's country: a two-letter ISO code such as US, or an English name such as United States

params.name: destination
params.description: The destination country or territory: a two-letter ISO code such as JP, or an English name such as Japan

vowelcounter.title: Vowel Counter
vowelcounter.description: Vowel Counter analyzes text to count vowels and consonants, providing detailed breakdowns and percentages for linguistic analysis.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to analyze (max 50,000 characters)

vpndetector.title: VPN Proxy Detector
vpndetector.description: VPN Proxy Detector checks any IP address to detect active VPN connections and cloud datacenter hosting. Lookups return boolean flags for VPN and datacenter status plus the verification date, with paid tiers adding Tor detection and risk levels.

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address you want to check for VPN usage

weatheralerts.title: Weather Alerts
weatheralerts.description: Weather Alerts returns the severe weather warnings, watches and advisories in effect right now for any point or state in the United States, straight from the National Weather Service. Each alert names the event, how severe and urgent it is, the area covered, when it starts and ends, and what to do.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude of the location to check. Send with lon

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude of the location to check. Send with lat

params.name: state
params.description: Two-letter US state or territory code (e.g., MO) for every alert in effect across it. Used when lat and lon are not sent

weatherforecast.title: Weather
weatherforecast.description: Weather is a current weather API that reports conditions for any city name or zip code: real-time temperature and wind speed with compass direction, in both metric and imperial units. Paid plans add a 7-day forecast with daily highs, lows, rain chance and conditions for the week ahead.

params.name: city
params.description: The city for which you want to get the current weather (e.g., San Francisco)

params.name: forecast
params.description: Included by default. Set to false to omit the 7-day forecast and return current conditions only.

weatherseasons.title: Weather Seasons
weatherseasons.description: Weather Seasons calculates astronomical solstice and equinox dates for any target year. It provides exact timestamps and reference timezones for the March and September equinoxes and the June and December solstices.

params.name: year
params.description: The year to get the dates of the solstice and equinox

webimagescraper.title: Website Images Scraper
webimagescraper.description: Website Images Scraper is an image scraper API that extracts image URLs and hosting domains from any web page. Send a page URL to retrieve direct image sources, breakdown counts for internal versus external assets, and unique hosting domains.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the website you want to scrape images from

params.name: maxlinks
params.description: The limit of image URLs returned from your query

params.name: includequery
params.description: Keep query strings on the scraped image URLs instead of trimming them

webpconverter.title: WebP Converter
webpconverter.description: WebP Converter transforms WebP images to classic formats like PNG and JPG, or converts other formats to WebP for better compression. Essential for handling modern web images.

params.name: outputFormat
params.description: Target format

params.name: quality
params.description: Output quality (applies to jpg/webp)

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: Maximum width in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: Maximum height in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

webscreenshots.title: Website Screenshot
webscreenshots.description: Website Screenshot renders webpage screenshots from any URL into PNG, JPEG, or WebP format. It returns a signed download link with an expiration timestamp, supporting custom viewport dimensions up to 3840 pixels wide.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to capture the screenshot (e.g., https://example.com)

params.name: type
params.description: The image format for the screenshot

params.name: width
params.description: The width of the screenshot in pixels (e.g., 1920). Must be between 100 and 3840

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the screenshot in pixels (e.g., 1080).  Must be between 100 and 3840

params.name: fullpage
params.description: Whether to capture the full page screenshot (true or false)

websitereadability.title: Website Readability
websitereadability.description: Website Readability analyzes live web pages to score their reading difficulty and educational grade level. It returns Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level, word count, sentence count, and estimated reading time.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to analyze

websitetopdf.title: Website to PDF
websitetopdf.description: Website to PDF renders any public web page into a PDF document from a submitted URL. It returns a temporary signed download link, unique filename, and expiration timestamp, with paid plans adding custom margins and landscape layout.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the website to convert to PDF

params.name: marginTop
params.description: The top margin of the PDF in inches (e.g., 0.4)

params.name: marginRight
params.description: The right margin of the PDF in inches (e.g., 0.4)

params.name: marginBottom
params.description: The bottom margin of the PDF in inches (e.g., 0.4)

params.name: marginLeft
params.description: The left margin of the PDF in inches (e.g., 0.4)

params.name: landscape
params.description: Set to true for landscape orientation

websitetotext.title: Website to Text
websitetotext.description: Website to Text converts any webpage URL into plain text stripped of HTML tags. It returns the extracted body copy, page title, meta description, publication date, and detected language code.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the website to convert to text

whoislookup.title: WHOIS Lookup
whoislookup.description: WHOIS Lookup is a domain WHOIS API that reads the registry's RDAP or WHOIS record for any domain and returns the registrar, creation and expiry dates, nameservers, EPP status codes explained in plain English, transfer-lock and privacy flags, the registrant country where it is published, and domain age in days and years.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain name for which you want to get the registration data (e.g., myspace.com)

wordladder.title: Word Ladder Generator
wordladder.description: Word Ladder Generator creates puzzles where players transform one word into another by changing one letter at a time, with each step forming a valid word.

params.name: start
params.description: Starting word (3-6 letters)

params.name: end
params.description: Ending word (same length as start)

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty level

params.name: count
params.description: Number of puzzles

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

wordlehelper.title: Wordle Helper
wordlehelper.description: Wordle Helper is a Wordle solver API that finds possible 5-letter word solutions based on known letter positions, letters in wrong positions, and eliminated letters.

params.name: green
params.description: Correct letters with positions (e.g., A1 means A at position 1)

params.name: yellow
params.description: Letters in word but wrong position (e.g., R2 means R not at position 2)

params.name: gray
params.description: Letters not in the word

params.name: pattern
params.description: Pattern with known letters (use _ for unknown)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of suggestions

wordopposite.title: Word Opposites
wordopposite.description: Word Opposites looks up direct antonyms for any single input term. Pass an English word to receive an array of contrasting and opposing words.

params.name: word
params.description: The word to get the opposites for

wordpronunciation.title: Word Pronunciation
wordpronunciation.description: Word Pronunciation is a pronunciation API that retrieves the phonetic pronunciation of any English word in ARPAbet format. Pass a word to receive its phonetic transcription for speech synthesis, dictionaries, or language tools.

params.name: word
params.description: The word to get the pronunciation of

wordrhymes.title: Rhyming Words
wordrhymes.description: Rhyming Words finds matching rhymes for any query word, returning a list of rhyming words and a total match count. Paid plans can adjust the maximum number of rhymes returned.

params.name: word
params.description: The word for which you want to get rhyming words

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of word rhymes returned

wordscramble.title: Word Scramble Generator
wordscramble.description: Word Scramble Generator is a scramble word API that creates puzzles where players unscramble letters to form words, returning each scrambled sequence with its answer and letter count.

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty level (affects word length)

params.name: count
params.description: Number of puzzles

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

wordsearch.title: Word Search Generator
wordsearch.description: Word Search Generator is a word search API that creates customizable word search puzzles with configurable grid size, word placement, and difficulty levels.

params.name: words
params.description: Array of words to hide in the puzzle (3-20 words)

params.name: size
params.description: Grid size

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty level (affects word directions)

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

params.name: solutionImage
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable solution image

wordstonumbers.title: Words to Numbers
wordstonumbers.description: Words to Numbers converts spelled-out number phrases into numeric digits. Pass written words to receive the calculated number, formatted English notation, and total digit counts.

params.name: words
params.description: The words to convert to numbers
params.example: seven thousand six hundred and twenty

workingdays.title: Working Days
workingdays.description: Working Days is a working days and business days API that counts the working days and non-working days for any country and month. Pass a two-letter country code and month number to get total counts, working date lists, and non-working days marked with holiday names.

params.name: country
params.description: The 2-letter country code you want to get the number of working days for

params.name: month
params.description: The month you want to get the number of working days for

params.name: year
params.description: The year you want to get the number of working days for

worldholidays.title: World Holidays
worldholidays.description: World Holidays lists public holidays and observances for any two-letter country code. It returns holiday dates, official names, and event types across the year.

params.name: country
params.description: The 2-letter country code for which you want to get the holidays

params.name: year
params.description: The year for which you want to get the holidays

worldtime.title: World Time
worldtime.description: World Time looks up the current local time, date, and timezone for any city. Search by city name to get matching locations with country codes, IANA timezone identifiers, and formatted times in 12-hour and 24-hour formats.

params.name: city
params.description: The city name for which you want to get the current time (e.g., New York)

xmltojson.title: XML to JSON
xmltojson.description: XML to JSON is an XML to JSON converter API that turns raw XML strings into structured JSON objects. Send any valid XML payload to receive an organized JSON tree preserving tags, attributes, and child elements.

params.name: xml
params.description: The XML content to convert to JSON

zipcodes.title: Zip Codes Lookup
zipcodes.description: Zip Codes Lookup finds all postal codes within a US city or resolves a five-digit ZIP code to its city and state. Paid plans add geographic coordinates.

params.name: zip
params.description: The zip code for which you want to get the data

zipdemographics.title: ZIP Demographics
zipdemographics.description: ZIP Demographics is a demographic data API for any US ZIP code, built on the US Census American Community Survey. Every plan gets total population and median household income, while paid plans add age, per-capita income, education, housing, employment, and racial composition.

params.name: zip
params.description: 5-digit US ZIP code
